newsitem.title: GREECE: HELLENIC BOTTLING 96 PRETAX DOWN 8.4PCT TO 23.2BLN DRS.
newsitem.headline: HELLENIC BOTTLING 96 PRETAX DOWN 8.4PCT TO 23.2BLN DRS.

text.p: Greece's leading bottler Hellenic Bottling said in a statement that consolidated pretax profits after allowing for capital gains and minority interests fell 8.4 percent to 23.2 billion drachmas in 1996.
Group profits from Greek operations rose 8.4 percent to 23.3 billion drachmas in 1996 due to productivity gains and cost control but sales volume was marginally higher, it said.
Hellenic Bottling's Bulgarian operations posted a loss of 2.0 billion drachmas in 1996 due to the collapse of the lev, more than offseting profits from Greek operations, it added.
Consolidated sales were flat at 143 billion drachmas in 1996, it said.
Hellenic Bottling posted sales of 143.6 billion drachmas in 1995.

The financial statements for fiscal 1996 have been prepared in accordance with the international standard for reporting in hyperinflation economies. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
